test_title: PYST 23: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting in a straight line facing the north (but not necessarily in the same order) . M is sitting at one of the ends of the line. P is sitting to the immediate right of M. N is sitting to the immediate right of P and the immediate left of L. Q is sitting to the immediate right of O and the immediate left of R. L is sitting to the immediate right of N. Who is sitting between M and N?
solution:
Given: Seven people L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting in a straight line facing the north (but not necessarily in the same order) .

M is sitting at one of the ends of the line.

P is sitting to the immediate right of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/167f0666ab21b61b22f906beb4467dffb0e4e2b80a9f53fa3c77eb42dbd9a301.png] 

N is sitting to the immediate right of P and the
 immediate left of L.

Q is sitting to the immediate right of O and the immediate left of R.

L is sitting to the immediate right of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62026ff547b9e42b9656008c2572bc3bfb164d3f5ee734f45b5a1f83a4acba71.png] 

P is sitting between M and N.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
